title: Tiɣbula
lede: Tugniwin n usmel-agi usant-id seg Wikimedia Commons. Tanemmirt i wid i tent-yewwin, i imuzganen akked yimttekkiyen i tent-id-yesersen ddaw tsirag taḥerrit.
imagesText: Yal tugna teffeɣ-d s ɣur bab-is ddaw tsirag i d-yettwabedren (adeg azayez, CC BY, CC BY-SA neɣ Tasirag n Tsekla Tilelli). Tugniwin-nni ttwabeddlent lmizan-nsent dɣa ttwaṣeggment i web.
textText: Isebtar-agi ttekkint ɣef wid yuran si zik, ɣef lxedma n yimezruyen d yimassanen n tqdimt (wali tabibliyugrafit), akked yimagraden n Wikipedia s tefransist, ddaw tsirag CC BY-SA 4.0, i deg talɣut tettwabeddel tettwasenqed.
dataText: Takarṭa yettbeddilen: tilisa n Natural Earth (adeg azayez) s ubrid n world-atlas, ttwabeggnent s D3. Tilisa n zik ur llint ara s tseḥqiqt, d tamuɣli kan ɣef wanda i tettawi tezmert n yal tamurt.
fontsText: Archivo, Instrument Sans, Noto Sans Phoenician akked Noto Naskh Arabic, ttwafernent sɣur Google Fonts ddaw tsirag SIL Open Font License.
meta: Tiɣbula n tugniwin, n lqaɛa n tkarṭa akked tsekkilin n usmel Qarṭaǧ.
